description: Packages this workbench distributes to other local workbenches. Sync-Packages.ps1 reads this to know what a package consists of, and UserSettings/package-targets.json to know where it goes. Format notes: Common/PACKAGE_PROPAGATION.md

rootFiles.sync.ps1: Spec-driven project mirror. What each project mirrors lives in that workbench's Projects/<name>/mirror.json, so this one script serves every mirror model. Workbenches that mirror a source repository should take this file instead of forking it.

AgentSessionSync.description: Thin adapter for the external agent session transport tool.

WorkbenchStateSync.description: Thin adapter for the external workbench state transport tool.

ProjectSync.description: Mirror contract: reads a protected source repository into baseline/ and edit/<agent>/. Only for workbenches that actually mirror a source repository.
